delivery.title: Kuendesa zvakadzama - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: A "Pass" pano zvinoreva chete kuti server yakanangwa yakapetudza HTTP 2xx mamiriro - hazvisimbisi kuti system yekugamuchira yakachengetedzwa kana kugadzirisa kutungamira. Tarisa muviri wemhinduro uri pamusoro kuti wakanyatsoti chii; kana zvisina chiro kana kungobvuma, iyo system ingave ichigamuchira chikumbiro asi ichiramba kana kusafunga nezve payload mukati (mazita emunda / format yakashata ye API yayo , munda unodiwa parutivi payo kuti payload iyi haisanganisi, nezvimwewo).

push.title: Kubuda Webhooks - Sunda Inotungamira & Zvinogadziriswa
push.intro: Inokwanisa kugadziriswa zvakakwana nge webhook : JSON , Fomu (x-www-fomu-urlencoded), kana yako pachako Custom muviri template ine <fieldkey></fieldkey> vanobata nzvimbo (semuenzaniso <example></example> ) - inoshanda sekuzadza murairo cURL kamwe.
push.curlHelp: Paste muenzaniso chikumbiro chavo API docs kana Postman inokupa (ine chaiyo kana muenzaniso data). The URL , njira uye misoro inokopwa se-iri, uye kiyi imwe neimwe mumuviri yakanyorwa pazasi kuti ukwanise kusarudza kuti ndeupi munda CRM unoizadza kune imwe neimwe inotungamira.
push.curlPrompt: Une cURL yemutengi ? <action>Import kubva ku cURL</action> kuti uzadze izvi uye mepu minda otomatiki.
push.headersInvalid: Misoro inofanira kunge yakashanda JSON , semuenzaniso {{example}}
push.authTitle: Kuvimbiswa (kuti Leadrat inosaina sei ku API yavo ) .
push.modeSame: Tumira chiitiko chega chega kune imwechete URL
push.modeCreateUpdate: Nasira rekodhi kamwe, wozogadzirisa rekodhi imweyo (apana zvakadzokororwa parutii rwavo)
push.responseIdHint: Apo ID iri JSON yavo mhinduro kune chikumbiro chekugadzira. Yakachengetedzwa ngekutungamira se <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Kune nguwa yekupera, HTTP 429 uye 5xx zvikanganiso - mushure meminiti imwe, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h.
push.howFilled: Kuti zviro zvinokosha zvinodzadzwa sei: webhook iyi inoshandiswazve kune mutungamiri wega wega - Leadrat haitumiri muenzaniso wakagadzikana, inotuma kusundira patsva nguva imwe neimwe chiitiko chakasarudzwa chinoitika, ngezviro zvinokosha zvemazuva ano zve THAT lead.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Fomu inozviita yega inosanganisira munda wega wega pamusoro pekutungamira - hapana chekuisa.
push.howFilledCustom: Tsika - nyora muiri wako wechikumbiro wodonhedza chero kwauri; imwe neimwe inochinjwa nekukosha kwechokwadi kwe lead iyoyo asati atumira. Dzvanya shanduko iri pazasi kuti uiise.
push.rawTemplate: Muviri Template (mbishi) - gadzirisa zvakananga kana kuisa shanduko
push.previewEmpty: (nyora template yemuviri pamusoro kuti uone kutanga)
push.resyncTruncated_one: Resync yakasundire yekutanga {{total}} ye {{count}} kutungamirira (muganhu {{limit}} ngekumhanya). Narrow zuva siyana kuti kusundire vamwe.

receive.title: Kuashira - Kuashira Vanotungamira Mune Chero Chimiro
receive.intro: Chitubu chimwe nechimwe chinowana URL yayo . Point Facebook inotungamira ads, Zapier , fomu rewebhusaiti kana imwe CRM 's webhook pairi - vanotuma vanotungamira JSON yavo kana fomu fomu, uye iwe unoita mepu yeminda yavo kune yako.
receive.urlIntro: URL yako yekugamuchira - ipa izvi kune system yekutumira ( POST , JSON kana fomu-yakanyorwa):
receive.newUrlConfirm: Kugadzira URL itsva ? Iyo yekare inosiya kushanda pakarepo.
receive.sendExample: Tumira muenzaniso umwe kutanga - unobatwa semuenzaniso (apana chinounzwa kuguma mapping iri pashi yakachengetedzwa).

pull.title: Dhonza - Tora Zvinotungamira kubva kune chero API
pull.intro: Leadrat inodaidza imwe system ye API pane purogiramu (chero auth, chero paging) uye inopinza marekodhi ayo anodzoka. Marekodhi ayo akaona asati update imwechete kutungamirira.
pull.variables: Zvinosiyana: <since></since> (kupedzisira kubudirira kumhanya, nguva yeISO; isina chiro nguva yekutanga), <others></others>
pull.sampleHelp: Save, wozotora muenzaniso - Leadrat inodaidza API kamwe (peji yekutanga chete) uye haina kuendesa chiro.

api.title: API yako - Nzira mbiri dzekuwana chero system
api.intro: Chero sisitimu ine API yako kiyi inokona kugadzira, kuerenga uye kunasirisa vanotungamira uye kunyoresa kutungamirira zviitiko. Tumira kiyi mu <hdr></hdr> musoro, se <bearer></bearer> , kana (kana chiro chisingakoni kuisa misoro) se <query></query> . Muganhu: {{limit}} zvikumbiro paminiti.
api.noPermission: Munthu ega ane mvumo yeKuchengetedza Zvirongwa ndiye anokona kuona kiyi API .
api.shownOnce: Kopa kiyi iyi zvino woichengeta pandau yakachengeteka - ngendaa yekuchengeteka inokombidzwa kamwe chete. Kana yakarashika, ita imwe itsva.
api.regenerateConfirm: Kugadzira kiyi itsva API ? Kiyi yemazuwa ano inomira kushanda pakarepo kune imwe neimwe system inoishandisa.
api.openApiHint: Kupinza OpenAPI spec Postman , Zapier , Ita kana n8n kuti uwane magumo ese akagadzirira kushandisa.
